description: oc-be-tools: ad-hoc work ends up like an /oc-be-implement run. An analysis checkpoint and per-layer guideline loading hold the first edit once; script edits are captured for the AI-usage metrics; at milestones (tests green, Claude's git commit) review -> record AI usage -> commit is suggested; commits made anywhere are offered for recording afterwards

hooks.command: if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py" --session-start; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py" --session-start; fi

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *commit*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=python3; fi; printf "%s" "$input" | "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py" --pre-commit

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *python*|*node*|*perl*|*ruby*|*sed*|*awk*|*'>'*|*tee*|*-Content*|*Out-File*|*Copy-Item*|*Move-Item*|*'cp '*|*'mv '*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=python3; fi; printf "%s" "$input" | "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py" --pre-script

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *python*|*node*|*perl*|*ruby*|*sed*|*awk*|*'>'*|*tee*|*-Content*|*Out-File*|*Copy-Item*|*Move-Item*|*'cp '*|*'mv '*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=python3; fi; printf "%s" "$input" | "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py" --post-script
if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py"; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ai_use_watch.py"; fi
